newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures slip, pressured by firmer yen.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures slip, pressured by firmer yen.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower across the board on Friday after sluggish trade, pressured by the yen's firmer tendency against the dollar, traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.1 yen to 1.9 yen per kg lower.
Benchmark September was off 1.2 yen at 144.9 yen.
The market started the day on a weaker tone.
Activity was mainly dominated by sporadic profit-taking and position-adjustment trade ahead of the weekend.
"Volume remained thin and prices drifted within tight ranges amid a lack of fresh incentives," one trader said.
